visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with black hair and earrings stands on a balcony against a tiled wall. He wears a light blue t-shirt and looks sideways with a slight smile. The background shows a hazy urban cityscape with various rooftops. (2) The man brings a black mirrorless camera to his eye. A rapid montage begins, starting with a narrow alleyway filled with glowing red lanterns and people holding umbrellas on a rainy night. (3) A nighttime view of the Taipei 101 skyscraper is shown from the perspective of an illuminated glass entrance to a metro station. Pedestrians walk by in the foreground. (4) The scene shifts to a pond filled with massive green lily pads; a person is lying down on one of them in the center of the frame. (5) At sunset, a silhouette of a person holds a camera up to photograph large white wind turbines against a colorful orange and blue sky by the coast. (6) After a brief black transition, the video shows a series of mundane items: a metallic bottle opener on a wooden table, a bag of snacks resting on a POS monitor in a store, and a wide shot of a large indoor hall with a checkered floor where dozens of people are sitting. (7) The final shots include a close-up of a yellow bicycle saddle with a smiley logo and a surreal white mannequin wearing a giant yellow bird head standing in a public hallway.
